text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stairs leading up to the rooftop are 
unusually noisy. Following the students up 
to the rooftop, I see everyone watching 
from a distance—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Look at those captivating eyes gazing 
at the painting!" "Apparently, she's been 
like that for the past few days...?" "I 
wonder what could be on her mind..."
choice_data_list:
(Is that the... "painting from the past" 
from the other day?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the painting Mejiro Ramonu was 
carrying from the art room before. If I 
recall, it was a piece from her elementary 
school days, and she was contemplating 
retouching it or not...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Um... excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I heard there was quite a commotion, so I 
came to check... Sister, what on earth is 
going on here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Who knows...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... If I had to guess... your fans 
gathered here entirely on their own, 
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Sister, what are you... Oh, that 
painting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What do you think... of this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... It leaves a deep 
impression on me as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Our Mejiro family's annual winter training 
camp... This was painted back then, wasn't 
it? At that time, Sister, you still had 
concerns about your legs—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Unable to take part in the snow training, 
you had no choice but to stay cooped up in 
the lodge, painting all by yourself...

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister, it's almost time for dinner... 
Eek! Wh-What... kind of painting is that?

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... it's roaring and swirling... It 
feels kind of scary... and it aches.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes... it aches.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just yearning for it hurts this much...

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister...? Does somewhere hurt? Should I 
call a doctor...?

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hehe... No need.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I understand it well. If this pain 
disappears, I will no longer be me.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is far better to remain scorched. I 
will wait... until the day I can embrace 
it...

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sis... ter... ...Eep!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I ran straight to nanny... I suppose your 
intense passion back then... was simply 
terrifying to me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Which is why... even seeing it now, I 
still find it frightening. That is how I 
feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
An immature love, indeed. Back then, I 
didn't even realize it was love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I would never acknowledge an 
imperfect love. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that you are hesitating 
over whether to touch up this painting or 
not? That would mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have been pondering this ever 
since that moment. If she is hesitating, 
isn't that the answer in itself? In other 
words, this painting, including its 
immaturity, is a complete...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A history of love.
choice_data_list:
Ah, sorry for jumping in! But that's what 
came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Respecting the path traversed, 
leaving it as it was back then. Indeed, 
one could certainly call that a history of 
love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The past is the past. What I ought to 
depict... is the love of the present.
